paragraphs.text: Platypus is a creature type , used for cards depicting a species of semiaquatic egg -laying mammal which frequents lakes and streams. It has a sensitive pliable bill shaped like that of a duck, webbed feet with venomous spurs, and dense fur.
Only a single platypus been printed so far. Consequently, platypus does not have a standard color in which it appears, though this may change in the future.
Platypus debuted in the Universes Beyond set Avatar: The Last Airbender on the hybrid creature Platypus-Bear .
In Avatar: The Last Airbender the Platypus bear is a large egg laying mammal found in the Earth Kingdom.
